# Instructions for Creating Advanced Power Pivot Table Reports from
Commissioner Tools Reports

In just a few seconds, Power Pivot tables can take your raw Commissioner Tools
report data and create advanced reports. The Power Pivot table files were
volunteer-developed and are NOT supported by Scouting America’s Information
Delivery Group.

**Presently, these tools work only on a Windows-based computer with Excel 2013
and newer; they do not work with Excel 2010 and earlier.**

We hope to expand the supported user base in the future. For assistance with
these Power Pivot tables, please contact
[commissioner.support@scouting.org](mailto:commissioner.support@scouting.org)
and a volunteer will respond to you.

Creating Reports for Use with the PowerPivot Tools With the release of the new
version of Commissioner Tools, it may be helpful to learn how to create best
reports to work with the PowerPivot Tools: [Creating Reports for Use with the
PowerPivot Tools](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2019/05/Creating-Reports-for-use-with-the-PowerPivot-
Tools.pdf) (PDF)

### Primary Tools

**Documentation**      Region/Area     Council     District

Step-by-Step Instructions for Using Power Pivot Tables

[3×5 Job Aid Handout](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2019/05/PPTool_JobAid.docx) (Two-sided, designed for the Avery
5388 stock)



**Unit Contact Analysis**      Region/Area     Council     District

(Autoload & ability to process multiple councils.

_Uses BOTH the District_Contact_Stats and the Assigned_Units reports)_

[New Tool Download December 2021](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2022/01/Unit_Contact_Analysis-NST.xlsx)

[Sample Download](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2018/10/Unit_Contact_Analysis_2018.pdf)



**Roundtable Analysis – Program Year**      Council     District

content/uploads/2021/09/RT_Assessment_Tool_py.xlsx)

[Sample Download](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2018/10/RT_Assessment_py.pdf)



**District Commissioner Visual Analysis**      Council     District

**Units Needing Assistance**      Region/Area     Council     District
